propositions: A new blocking check p10_verification_presence must verify that leaf plans contain either a Testing/Verification H2 section, or AC items with code spans or vocabulary matches (pytest, test_, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, verif, checked:, exit code).

A new blocking check p11_ac_vagueness must flag vague AC language using a fixed word-boundary lexicon (excluding 'clean', including 'etc.') with exemptions for inline code spans and 'etc.' within 30 characters after a span.
The p6_ac_quality check remains advisory and shares the p11 fixed lexicon so both surfaces agree on vagueness detection.
Code-span positions recorded on original AC lines must prevent lexicon matches inside spans and exempt nearby 'etc.' occurrences from firing.

Ten enumerated false-positive fixture lines from backtesting ('make lint exits 0', 'mypy --strict runs clean', etc.) must not trigger p11, and three positive cases ('works properly', 'handles errors, etc.', 'reasonable performance') must fire.
Documentation in docs/plan-review-gate.md deterministic-floor section must be extended with P10 and P11 descriptions.
